api_name: Plants of the World Online (POWO) API
failure_mode: HTTP 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge and a "Just a moment... Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue" page, for every request
root_cause: Kew enabled Cloudflare's managed JavaScript challenge, the same as WormBase and FooDB. Passing it requires executing JavaScript and holding a cookie, which no HTTP client does, so this is not a credential, header or rate-limit problem. Verified 2026-10-03 on /api/2/search and /api/2/taxon.
retry_notes: GET https://powo.science.kew.org/api/2/search?q=Quercus with no special headers. A 200 means the challenge is off. While the cf-mitigated header reads 'challenge' there is nothing to implement on this side.
workaround: None from an API client. POWO is browsable by a human at the site. These tools are config-driven (BaseRESTTool), so the challenge is now named by the shared error path rather than per tool -- POWO reported only 'POWO_search_plants API error' before, which sends a user looking for a credential problem.
investigation_notes: Found in the 2026-10-03 sweep as 6 failures under the powo category, originally filed as 'other -- needs reading' because the message said nothing. Third instance of this signature after wormbase and foodb, which is why the detection moved into BaseRESTTool where every config-driven tool shares it.
